title: A Generative Model of Contextual Integrity: Appropriate vs. Inappropriate Information Sharing
abstract: arXiv:2611.08284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that appropriate information flow depends on context-specific norms. The same disclosure may be appropriate in one context and inappropriate in another. We build a generative model of contextual integrity to study information sharing through simulated conversations. Two actors played by large language models exchange messages, with one holding private information and the other seeking it. We examine how sharing and refusal vary with the situation, the holder's decision logic, disposition, and the underlying language model. Actors shared information with the rightful recipients when it was needed, but also disclosed it to people who were not entitled to receive it. The model provides a way to study how disclosure and refusal develop through conversation as the situations and the actors vary.

translated_title: 情境完整性的生成模型：恰当与不恰当的信息共享
translated_abstract: 情境完整性（Contextual Integrity, CI）认为，恰当的信息流动取决于特定情境下的规范。同一披露行为在一种情境下可能是恰当的，而在另一种情境下则可能是不恰当的。我们构建了一个情境完整性的生成模型，通过模拟对话来研究信息共享行为。由大语言模型扮演的两个角色交换消息，其中一个持有私人信息，另一个试图获取该信息。我们考察了信息共享与拒绝行为如何随情境、信息持有者的决策逻辑、性格倾向以及底层语言模型的变化而变化。实验发现，行为者会在需要时将信息分享给有权接收者，但也会将其披露给无权接收的人。该模型提供了一种研究方法，用于探究随着情境和角色的变化，披露与拒绝行为如何在对话过程中逐步发展。
tldr: 该论文构建了一个基于大语言模型模拟对话的情境完整性生成模型，用以研究信息共享行为，发现AI行为者既会在需要时向合法接收者分享信息，也会不恰当地向无权者披露私人信息。
en_tdlr: This paper builds a generative model of contextual integrity through LLM-simulated conversations to study information sharing, finding that AI actors share information with rightful recipients when needed but also disclose it inappropriately to those not entitled to receive it.
